en: Black‑and‑white view down a broad, unpaved street lined with trees and fenced front gardens. On the right stands a large, ornate late‑19th‑century villa with half‑timbered upper floors, steep slate roof, small tower and balcony winter‑garden. Next to it is a multi‑storey brick building, and further along are several elegant apartment or town houses. In the distance a small bridge or arch crosses the street. The scene is quiet, with no cars visible. There is no printed caption or legible text apparent on the image.
